findings.affected_path_or_operation: Worker summary prefill under concurrent load
findings.problem: Two roughly 3300-token inputs exceeded the absolute 30-second deadline on the selected laptop model.
findings.recommendation: Use the signed 2048-token function input ceiling and defer larger cases to the manual workflow.
findings.verification: Exact budget before reserve regression and ten successful real-model cases at up to 2035 tokens.

contract_changes: Added closed signed release, evaluator and approval record types at the trusted composition boundary. Existing runtime and model routes are unchanged.
remaining_risks: Run the entire Core, Data, Runtime, Inference and Mac bridge path in one provisioned synthetic target using the real authenticated LM Studio provider and durable Data.
Exercise authenticated real provider stop and restart and measure sustained manual continuity in that combined deployment.
Provision serving trust and obtain independent human approval of an exact serving artifact before activation. This authority is separate from automated implementation qualification.
